name.title: Name
name.description: Username for the new user. Used as the user's directory name; whitespace-only names are rejected.

user_name.title: User Name
user_name.description: Display name of the user. Required (non-blank).

email_address.title: Email Address
email_address.description: Email address of the user. Required (non-blank).

password.title: Password
password.description: Plaintext password for the new user; it is hashed before storage.

ssh_private_key.title: Ssh Private Key
ssh_private_key.description: SSH private key associated with the user.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Names of the roles to assign to this user.
